# Solitito guitar chord model (MIT)

Bundled from https://huggingface.co/greblus/solitito-ai and https://github.com/greblus/solitito (MIT).

Files:
- `best_model_v2_take6_chords.onnx` — recognition model (~29 MB)
- `dsp_weights.json` — sparse pseudo-CQT kernel
- `LICENSE` — MIT

GuitarSet training data is CC BY 4.0 (see Solitito README). PedalBeat uses this only for the **Guitar (Solitito)** Bass Follow profile.
